title: The merge-confirm-repo guard names the bad head sha when it refuses a 12 character --head, not the repo
why: Sighting (runner 10, 06:45 CST Nov 14; sent to triage 06:47, relayed; as data, the guard record and code unread by triage): the guard merge-confirm-repo refused a 12-character `--head` with a message about the repo, not about the sha; the full 40-character sha passed. Mistake it made: it read a refusal that named the wrong cause. Harm: one refused call and a retry; no wall measured. Fix: the refusal tells the true cause (a short or unresolved sha) and the way out (pass the full 40-character sha); or the tool accepts a 12-character prefix that resolves to one commit. A message-only change is not a guard verdict change; accepting the prefix is, and then round 3 applies. Kin: refusal-names-way-out. Red first: a 12-character head gets a message that names the sha; a wrong repo still gets the repo message.
note: Filed 06:52 CST Nov 14 by triage. Tracker: the coordinator. No lane yet.
